introSection.title: Build an App That Moves Your Business Forward.
introSection.lead: A mobile app is often the most direct relationship you have with your customer — it lives on their phone, competes for their attention, and needs to earn a reason to be opened again tomorrow.
paragraphs: At FuduGo, we combine design, development, platform strategy, and AI-assisted engineering to build apps around how your users actually behave.
Whether you need a customer-facing app, an internal business tool, or a platform to launch on both iOS and Android, we build experiences designed for retention, not just installs.

features.title: Fewer Bugs at Launch

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Common questions regarding our mobile app design, cross-platform engineering, and AI-assisted development workflow.

items.question: What does FuduGo offer in mobile app development?
items.answer: FuduGo provides native and cross-platform app development, mobile UI/UX design, app store deployment, and ongoing maintenance and support after launch.

items.question: Do you build apps for both iOS and Android?
items.answer: Yes. We build native apps for each platform when needed, or cross-platform apps using React Native or Flutter when a shared codebase better fits your timeline and budget.

items.question: Does FuduGo use AI for app development?
items.answer: Yes. FuduGo uses AI-assisted coding tools to help developers with code suggestions, faster implementation of common features, and identifying potential issues during development.

items.question: Does AI build the entire app?
items.answer: No. AI is used selectively as a development assistant. FuduGo's developers remain responsible for architecture, business logic, code review, testing, and final implementation.

items.question: Can you add AI features to my app?
items.answer: Yes, where AI provides a meaningful business or user benefit. Potential applications include intelligent search, recommendations, in-app automation, and other AI-powered functionality.
